altText: Short animated video with on-screen captions. Handwriting appears on squared paper as if written by a cartoon pen, with Em’s three coloured circles in the top corner. Opens with the title ‘Fractions: all four, step by step’. First, 1/3 + 1/4 = 2/7 is written in orange, the circles wobble with a ‘hmm’, and 2/7 is crossed out. Underneath: = 4/12 + 3/12 = 7/12, ringed in green with a tick. Next: 5/6 − 1/3 = 5/6 − 2/6 = 3/6 = 1/2, ticked, with the note ‘÷3 top and bottom’. Then 2/3 × 3/5 = 6/15 = 2/5, ticked, note ‘÷3’. Then 3/4 ÷ 1/2 = 3/4 × 2/1, note ‘flip the 2nd’, then = 6/4 = 3/2, ticked, note ‘or 1½’. The circles celebrate. Ends with ‘Show every step.’ and the Educate Me AI logo.

platforms.label: Instagram Reel
platforms.caption:
Fractions, all four ways. Adding or subtracting: make the bottoms the same first (1/3 + 1/4 is 4/12 + 3/12 = 7/12, not 2/7). Multiplying: top × top, bottom × bottom. Dividing: keep the first fraction, change ÷ to ×, flip the second.

Then simplify: 3/6 is 1/2, 6/15 is 2/5. Write every step, because working can earn marks even if the final answer slips.
